member_reasons.nist_sp_800_53_rev_5_security_and_privac: NIST SI-4(20) — additional monitoring of privileged users.

exclusion_reasons.nist_sp_800_53_rev_5_security_and_privac: AU-9(4) protects audit-log management access — audit protection (SD-06.01), not privileged-user monitoring.

differences: Monitoring the activity of privileged users specifically. Boundary with SD-06.01 (Logging & Monitoring) is genuine.
decision_rationale: Privileged-user activity monitoring; single source. Confidence 0.7 -> review (SD-03.04 vs SD-06.01 boundary).

canonical_artifact.definition_short_en: This control requires additional monitoring of the activities performed by privileged users.
canonical_artifact.definition_full_en: This artifact requires enhanced monitoring of privileged-user activity so that misuse of elevated access can be detected. It applies to all privileged users and sessions. The minimum expected outcome is recorded, reviewable privileged-activity monitoring. Verification is by reviewing privileged-activity monitoring records.
canonical_artifact.classification_rationale: SI-4(20) privileged-user monitoring; SD-03.04 pending review vs SD-06.01.

source_mappings.source_document: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 — Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
